richiami.difetto: The material of certain front stub axle carriers may not be to specification and under extreme load conditions could crack.  In the event of total failure a wheel could separate from the coach affecting directional control increasing the risk of collision.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to identify the stub axle carriers. Where the stub axle carrier bears a casting identification showing it is affected the stub axle will be replaced. Later (4/11 � 12/14) stub axle carriers could require material testing to identify if replacement is necessary.

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the engine turbo may fail and leak oil into the engine induction/inlet system.  With the Van Hool induction/inlet track if it is not airtight oil is able to leak into the engine compartment. This will cause a fire hazard.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to check the induction/inlet system is airtight.

richiami.difetto: There is a significant delay before the entrance/exit door handbrake interlock system closes the door.
richiami.rimedio: (a) Write to operators and dealers requesting them to check the handbrake interlock time delay.  (b) In those cases where the delay is longer than 3 to 4 seconds a pressure switch will be fitted to the handbrake air pipe working on 2 bar pressure. The dealers and Van Hool UK will carry out the modification.

richiami.difetto: The space frame body on these vehicles may be subject to cracking in the area of the rear suspension attachment.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for reinforcement of the subject area of the frame.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE CRACKING OF THE SPACE FRAME
